Now I understand the issue. The current implementation:
1. Converts to lowercase
2. Replaces all non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens

This causes problems:
- `"Hello,  World!"` becomes `"hello--world-"` (double hyphens from consecutive non-alphanumeric chars, trailing hyphen from the `!`)
- `"--a--b--"` becomes `"--a--b--"` (leading and trailing hyphens)

The fix needs to:
1. Replace consecutive non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
2. Remove leading and trailing hyphens

Let me fix the `slugify` function:

def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Turn arbitrary text into a URL slug: lowercase, ASCII letters and
    digits, words separated by single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens."""
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)
    return text
arguments.new:
def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Turn arbitrary text into a URL slug: lowercase, ASCII letters and
    digits, words separated by single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens."""
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)
    text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)  # Replace consecutive hyphens with single hyphen
    text = text.strip("-")  # Remove leading and trailing hyphens
    return text
